sign_convention: difference = fair_line − market_line. SIDE and TOTAL are in points on the home handicap / combined-score scale. MONEYLINE is in probability points, because two American prices cannot be subtracted across the vig.

columns.definition: archived home handicap for the same game
columns.who_computes_it: nflverse/nfldata games.csv spread_line, sign inverted to the home handicap

columns.definition: fair_line − market_line; positive = model likes the HOME side more than the market
archived total for the same game
fair_line − market_line; positive = model expects more points than the market
de-vigged home win probability implied by the archived two-way moneyline
columns.who_computes_it: multiplicative de-vig of games.csv home/away moneyline

columns.definition: fair_line − market_line; positive = model rates the home team higher than the market

boundary: A fair line is a model estimate and a market line from this archive is an undated community value. The difference is arithmetic over the two; it is not an edge, because an edge requires an authenticated executable price.
